mana.text: Your mana stat is whichever of INT or WIS is higher (wiki Statistics); 101 of 123 wiki Shaman spells cost mana.
mana.label: FACT

wiki_advice: Listed below is the recommended allocation of bonus points by race. Since Wisdom is a Shaman’s main attribute, you should focus on maximizing it whenever possible. Wisdom is directly tied to your healing spells effectiveness and total mana. After that, prioritize Stamina. It gives you extra HP and a bit of stun resistance. Finally, put a point into Dexterity if you have any left. It affects hit rate across the board and increases your proc chance. Goblin: +4 Stamina and +6 Wisdom Human: +2 Stamina, +1 Dexterity, and +7 Wisdom Ogre: +2 Dexterity and +8 Wisdom Wood Elf: +3 Stamina and +7 Wisdom

traits.why: Wise: +5% base WIS and a 15-second +50% WIS burst.
Alteration is by far the biggest Shaman school on the wiki (87 of 123): buffs, slows and heals over time.
Readiness gives a Cantrip slot from level 1, so one memorized spell survives death.

Miner starts Mining at 25 with a Trainee's Mining Pick and Pouch, matching the default gathering setup (Mining, Lumberjacking, Smelting) for early coin. Medic (Bind Wound 25 and bandages) is the safer pick if you expect downtime between fights. Blacksmith exists but smithing stays off by default here.
